description: Review gate for shared agent memory: an unreviewed or hand-edited memory is never served.
name: io.github.logotheusneuro-cpu/procheiron

environmentVariables.description: Optional ed25519 private key hex for signed authorship (requires the 'crypto' extra). Mint one with `procheiron keygen`. Omit for tamper-evidence without signatures.
environmentVariables.name: PROCHEIRON_SIGNING_KEY

packageArguments.description: The procheiron CLI is subcommand-dispatched; the MCP server is `procheiron mcp`. Without this the invocation exits 2 before the server starts.
Path to the memory commons this server reads. Create one with `procheiron init <path>`.
packageArguments.name: --root

packageArguments.description: Bound client identity. Used as created_by for proposals and as the acting actor for the promotion gate, so an agent cannot review its own record.
packageArguments.name: --actor

title: Procheiron
